journal_lines: Dug because of the smell of iron. Was right.
Something buried here. The soil was wrong over it. Investigated.
Old chest in the sand. Waterlogged. Still had things in it.
A square shape under the grass that should not have been a square shape. Investigated.
Wood half-rotted, lock fully rusted. Opened with a tap. Inside, what the buryer had wanted kept.
Whoever buried it did not come back. The reason is not for me to know.
Sand had filled the chest where the lid had failed. Sand had not filled it everywhere.
Took the things that had survived. Left the rest to whatever buries things again.
